website.description: Simple accessibility tool for FFXIV that allows full color customization of all AOE omens/indicators.
website.readmeExcerpt:
Chroma

Accessibility plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that enables full color customization of AoE omens/indicators.



# ✨ Features ### 🎨 _Full Color Customization_ – Pick any color using an intuitive color menu with an adjustable **_Alpha_** slider to increase or decrease color intensity as you see fit. ### 🌈 _Rainbow Mode_ – A fun mode where all omens have their colors randomized by cycling through the color spectrum, along with a configurable **_Speed_** slider to control how fast or slow the colors change. ### ⚪ _White Mode_ – Another fun mode where all omens are turned into pure white. _(NOTE: This may cause rendering issues – use at your own risk)_ ### 🎯 _Duty Overrides_ – Set custom colors for specific duties/instances. These override your global color settings, giving you per‑duty control. ### 🛡️ _Include Non‑Hostile Omens_ – Customize the colors of safe (non‑hostile) AoE omens/indicators as well, along with a separate color menu. ### 🧪 _Testing_ – Test all omens yourself and fine‑tune everything to your liking before using them in live content.

# 📦 Installation ### Step **_1_**: _Prerequisites_ - **[XIVLauncher](https://goatcorp.github.io/)** is the only requirement to use this plugin. ### Step **_2_**: _Add Repository_ 1. Open the **_Dalamud Settings_** menu in‑game. You can do this by: - Clicking the button at the bottom of the Plugin Installer - Typing `/xlsettings` in chat 2. Navigate to the **_Custom Plugin Repositories_** section. 3. Paste the following repository URL into the input field: - `https://puni.sh/api/repository/akechi` 4. Click the **_`+`_** button. 5. Click **_Save and Close_**. ### Step **_3_**: _Install Plugin_ 1. Open the **_Dalamud Plugin Installer_** (type _`/xlplugins`_ in chat). 2. Select the **_All Plugins_** tab. 3. Search for **_Chroma_**. 4. Click **_Install_**. ### ✅ **_Done!_** Chroma is now installed and ready to use.
Feel free to get started by accessing the settings menu via the `/chroma` command.


# ⚠️ Troubleshooting No plugin is ever truly perfect.
If you encounter any issues or want to suggest any features, please submit them **_[here](https://github.com/Akechi-kun/Chroma/issues)_** and I will get to them as soon as I can. ✊🏽

---
Thank you for using my plugin! ❤️
